verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents a distinct MCP sandbox endpoint (mcp-sandbox.skyfire.xyz/mcp) separate from the production MCP server, implying agents can test commerce workflows without hitting live production data. However, there's no detailed documentation of sandbox wallets, test tokens, or isolation guarantees beyond this single endpoint mention. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox onboarding docs, test-mode wallet/token behavior, and confirmation that sandbox data/transactions are fully isolated from production.
